theorem_title: Subset setup returns the compact layer rank
formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightSubsetSetup.meets {pMain pBuild pFill pRow pLinear pPowers pRank : ℕ}
    (C : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightSubsetSetup.Procs P pMain pBuild pFill pRow pLinear pPowers pRank)
    {μ : ℕ → ℤ} {L k m work d : ℕ}
    (hw : (lim.space : ℤ) ≤ lim.word)
    (hspace : work+_root_.ThreeSum.LightPascal.tableSize L+(L+1) ≤ lim.space)
    (hword : ((2^(L+1) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ lim.word)
    (hm : _root_.ThreeSum.SubsetAddress.IsMask L k m) (hd : d+L+3 ≤ lim.depth) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Meets lim P pMain d [L,k,m,work] μ (_root_.ThreeSum.LightSubsetSetup.time L)
      (fun r μ' => r = (_root_.ThreeSum.SubsetAddress.layerRank L k m : ℤ) ∧ _root_.ThreeSum.LightPascal.Table μ' work L ∧
        _root_.ThreeSum.LightSubsetAddress.Powers μ' (work+_root_.ThreeSum.LightPascal.tableSize L) L ∧ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Kept μ μ' work) := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
For a valid width-$L$, cardinality-$k$ mask $m$, assume the subset-helper placement record, enough room for the Pascal and power tables at scratch $w$, $2^{L+1}$ fitting a word, and depth $d+L+3$. The procedure returns the exact layer rank, constructs both tables, and preserves memory below $w$, within the declared setup time.

This setup supplies the exact compact address and supporting tables used by source and transform programs.
